name: donut-chart
purpose: A part-to-whole chart drawn as a ring (donut) or a disc (pie): one slice per series, the total in the center, a legend beside it. It shares the cartesian chart's data model, palette, legend behavior and loading / empty / error surface, so a dashboard reads as one system. Each slice is the sum of its series values, so a time series passes straight in as its share of the range.
useWhen: Share of a small whole at a glance: top countries by blocked threats, traffic by protocol, cache hit versus miss.
A dashboard card where the total is the headline and the split is the context.
avoidWhen: Comparing close values or more than six slices → use `chart` with horizontal bars; angles are hard to compare.
Two slices → use `stat-tile` with the ratio; a two-slice pie says less than the number.
related: chart` — the cartesian sibling; same series model, so a dataset moves between them without reshaping.
chart-card` — the box a dashboard donut sits in.
stat-tile` — the total alone, with a delta.
bestPractices: Keep it to six slices or fewer; the seventh and beyond fold into Other automatically.
Order series by size so the largest slice starts at the top.
Use the center for the total and let hover or focus swap it to the active slice.
Pair it with the bar form of the same data when exact ranks matter (the console's country pie plus ordered bar).

props.name: series
props.doc: One slice per series; a slice is the sum of its values. The first six take the categorical slots, the rest fold into Other.

props.name: size
props.doc: Diameter of the ring: 128, 176 or 240 pixels.

props.name: cap
props.doc: Slices kept before the rest fold into Other.

props.name: otherLabel
props.doc: Name of the folded slice. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Other`).

props.name: totalLabel
props.doc: Caption under the total in the center. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Total`).

props.name: formatValue
props.doc: Formats the center value and legend values.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Renders a circular Skeleton and suppresses interaction.

props.name: refetching
props.doc: Holds the previous render at reduced opacity while new data loads.

props.name: error
props.doc: Error message; when set, a danger Alert replaces the ring.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.doc: Title of the empty state shown when every slice is zero. Empty uses the locale catalog (`No data available`).

props.name: emptyDescription
props.doc: Supporting line under the empty title: why the range is empty, or what to do next.

props.name: tableView
props.doc: Shows the data table in place of the ring. The table is always present for assistive tech.

events.name: slice-click
events.notes: Click on a slice, or Enter / Space on the focused chart; `series` is the consumer's own series object.

slots.name: empty-actions
slots.notes: Actions under the default EmptyState, such as a Clear filters button or a setup link. Ignored when `empty` replaces it.
